remarks: What a neighborhood, welcome home! Besides style and grace this immaculate colonial is nestled on a lush 1+Acre lot, in a sought after cul de sac neighborhood. The professionally landscaped front lawns are breathtaking. Family & friends are greeted by a warm & inviting double door entry way & foyer. On the right is a spacious, sun filled living room boasting 1 of 4 beautiful wood burning fireplaces. The den/office is located opposite, perfect for "work from home". Just beyond is your own oversized sized chef's kitchen, ready to entertain or gather as a family. Easy access to the oversized family room featuring large windows and french doors to bring in the sunlight. All overlooking your beautiful, large, level, peaceful backyard sanctuary & patio perfect for your morning coffee, evening refreshment or while easily entertaining family and friends with a barbecue - there is even plenty of room to add a pool. The second floor is home to the primary suite and all its luxuries. It also has 3 additional large bedrooms with oversized closets. Hardwood floors, recess lighting, crown molding, an oversized attached 2 car garage, and a 3 room in law apartment complete this pristine home. Come take advantage of all Stamford has to offer within minutes of this home, national & boutique shopping, recreational facilities including golf, medical facilities, parks, public transportation metro north, Merritt, New Canaan - making an easy commute. A perfect mix, not to be missed!
